text: {"lessons":["Selling winners brought satisfaction, but gains alone are not a reason to exit; I should weigh each holding’s outlook and role in the portfolio.","I held Stock C after buying more, then sold at a steep loss. I should reassess a weakening position promptly using evidence, not let reluctance to realize a loss dictate my decision.","My trades have sometimes followed recent price moves. I should use a consistent plan for entries, exits, and position sizing rather than react to short-term changes."]}
